name: Rights of Progression
source:
You are the Arbiter.

As planets apply to join your alliance of planets, it is up to you to approve or deny each request. It is your judgement, and their future lies in your hands.

[From [url=https://lemon-poppyseed-games.itch.io/rights-of-progression]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是仲裁者。

随着各个星球纷纷申请加入你们的星际联盟，每一份申请的批准与否都由你来定夺。裁决权在你，而它们的未来也掌握在你的手中。

[引自[url=https://lemon-poppyseed-games.itch.io/rights-of-progression]Itch.io[/url]]
